FAST INPUT

One center button,
four ways to add.

Tap the center + to type it in, or hold and slide for receipts, favorites, or a memo & D-day. After the amount, the next field opens on its own.

✎

Type it in

Enter the amount on the calculator, pick an account and category, done. Expense, income and transfer on one screen.

▣

Receipt

Helps read the date, store, total and items. Save it as one record or split it by item.

★

Favorites

Save things you buy often — coffee, lunch, transit — and add them for today in a tap.

◷

Memo & D-day

See the day's memo and upcoming anniversaries right between the dates in your ledger.

CARD & INSTALLMENT

Money you spent by card,
and money still to pay.

Card purchases count as spending on the day you buy; paying the card bill is a transfer that pays down the debt — so nothing gets counted twice.

✓
Upcoming card billsDue date, paying account and D-day in one row
✓
Auto-payHandled by payment account and due date
✓
InstallmentsEqual payment, equal principal or flat interest
✓
Pay off earlySettle future installments in one go

STATS

This month's flow,
in one photo and one line.

The first card in Stats compares this month's spending with last month and your 6-month average, and sums it up in one line. Then fixed vs. variable costs, the 6-month trend, and each category's share and change.

VEHICLE LOG

What your car costs,
right in your ledger.

Add your car, and fuel and service expenses also log mileage, fuel and replaced parts. Fuel economy, running costs and the next service are all on the Vehicle tab in Stats.

⛽

Fuel-ups in one entry

Log the odometer and fuel as you record the expense. Fuel economy and cost per mile are worked out for you.

⚙

Service reminders

Track oil, filters and tires by distance or time, and see what's overdue or coming up.

⚡

EVs and a second car

Gas, diesel, LPG, hybrid or electric; miles and gallons or km and liters. Add up to 2 cars for free.

◔

Vehicle stats

This month's running costs, 6-month cost and fuel economy charts, and maintenance items on one screen.

MONTHLY REVIEW

A story behind
each month's numbers.

Income, spending and savings rate, what changed since last month, fixed and variable costs, cards and installments, how your assets moved and what's coming next month — all on one screen.

✓A new review waits on your ledger when the month turns
✓Changes vs. last month and the last 3 months, in one line
✓Save and share it as a single image
Just like the name — Cash + Story — so each month's records add up to your money story.

ASSETS

From daily records
to the bigger picture.

See bank accounts, cash, cards, investments and loans one row each, with assets, debt and net worth in three boxes at the top. Card bills, recurring payments and transfers for the next 30 days are listed by date under Coming up in your ledger.

MEMO & D-DAY

Know the costly days
before they arrive.

Track anniversaries, birthdays and trips as D-days, and leave a memo for any day. They can repeat yearly or monthly, and show up between the dates in your ledger.

WIDGETS

Without opening the app,
right from your home screen.

Six widgets: this month's summary, quick expense and income entry, and a receipt shortcut. Set the background transparency to suit your home screen.

Monthly summary

This month's spending and income at a glance.

Quick add

Open expense or income entry in one tap.

Receipt shortcut

Snap a receipt straight from your home screen.

YOUR DATA

Your records, your control.

Your ledger is stored on your device. Back it up when you like, keep it as a file, and bring in records from other budget apps.
